knowledge_base.title: Acumax Wave Allocation Deadlocks & Database Sequence Locking Resolution SOP
knowledge_base.content:
OVERVIEW: During peak morning order volume, concurrent execution of bulk wave allocation and automated replenishment tasks can result in mutual resource deadlocks on table WAVE_HDR_DTL and index PK_WAVE_ALLOC. Symptoms include Wave status hanging in 'ALLOCATING', RF guns displaying 'WAVE_NOT_ACTIVE', and Oracle error ORA-00054 / ORA-00060.

DIAGNOSTIC CRITERIA:
1. Check active database locks using query: SELECT session_id, lock_type, mode_held FROM v$locked_object WHERE object_name = 'WAVE_HDR_DTL'.
2. Verify EAI gateway logs for timeout code EAI_ERR_504_GW_DEADLOCK.
3. Verify wave allocation worker thread state in Acumax WMS console.

REMEDIATION PROCEDURE (SOP-WMS-418):
Step 1: Identify and terminate the blocking background replenishment job session in Oracle DB.
Step 2: Reset the hung wave record status from 'ALLOCATING' to 'PENDING_RELEASE' using the approved DBA stored procedure: EXEC sp_acumax_wave_reset(wave_id => :WAVE_ID).
Step 3: Stagger allocation releases into sub-batches (maximum 5,000 order lines per wave slice) with 90-second spacing.
Step 4: Restart Acumax Wave Dispatcher thread pool.

OWNING SUPPORT GROUP: Acumax Support (Escalation to Core DBA Team).

knowledge_base.title: SAP EAI Middleware IDoc DELVRY03 Sequence Inversion & Queue Flusher SOP
knowledge_base.content:
OVERVIEW: Outbound deliveries generated in SAP ECC use IDoc message DELVRY03 transmitted via RFC to the EAI WebMethods/Broker message queue. If network latency or dual dispatcher threads cause IDocs to arrive out of strict chronological order, the EAI FIFO transformer rejects the message with IDOC_SEQ_MISMATCH_RECORD_REJECTED. The strict FIFO policy causes head-of-line blocking, accumulating tens of thousands of queued messages.

DIAGNOSTIC CRITERIA:
1. EAI broker queue depth > 5,000 on 'Q_SAP_TO_ACUMAX_DELVRY'.
2. Error message: IDOC_SEQ_MISMATCH_RECORD_REJECTED indicating expected seq N but received N+1.
3. Acumax inbound delivery tables show 0 incoming records while SAP SM58 / WE02 shows green dispatched status.

REMEDIATION PROCEDURE (SOP-EAI-389):
Step 1: Pause inbound broker ingestion on queue 'Q_SAP_TO_ACUMAX_DELVRY'.
Step 2: Execute EAI Quarantine Tool script to extract the offending out-of-order IDoc into the exception staging area.
Step 3: Trigger sequence re-sync utility: python /opt/eai/bin/resync_idoc_sequence.py --dc <DC_CODE> --expected <EXPECTED_SEQ>.
Step 4: Unpause queue broker with relaxed sequence tolerance mode for 15 minutes.
Step 5: Re-inject quarantined IDoc once baseline sequence catches up.

OWNING SUPPORT GROUP: EAI Support (Middleware Integration Operations).

knowledge_base.title: Sortation Conveyor Scanner Optical Divert Calibration & Jackpot Recirculation SOP
knowledge_base.content:
OVERVIEW: High-speed automated sortation lines utilize overhead optical line-scan cameras (Cognex / SICK) paired with trigger photo-eyes (PE-701) to read carton LPN barcodes within a 250ms window. If camera focus drifts, lens surfaces become obscured with corrugated dust, or conveyor belt tachometer timing slips, the WCS divergence engine registers SCAN_ERR_TIMEOUT_NO_READ and safely diverts cartons to the default jackpot recirculation loop.

DIAGNOSTIC CRITERIA:
1. Sortation Divert Error Rate exceeds 10% on designated lane.
2. WCS logs indicate SCAN_ERR_TIMEOUT_NO_READ.
3. Physical packages accumulating at jackpot loop high water sensor.

REMEDIATION PROCEDURE (SOP-AUTO-294):
Step 1: Route jackpot spur clear crew to manually scan and stage recirculated cartons to prevent physical jam.
Step 2: Clean optical scan head lenses using approved isopropyl wipes.
Step 3: In WCS Engineering UI, increase the barcode decode timeout window from 250ms to 380ms temporarily.
Step 4: Recalibrate belt speed tachometer pulse offset on PLC controller.
Step 5: Verify 10 test cartons divert accurately to shipping lanes 21-26.

OWNING SUPPORT GROUP: Conveyor & WCS Automation Ops.

knowledge_base.title: Truck Close & EDI 856 ASN Generation Failure with Ghost Split Items SOP
knowledge_base.content:
OVERVIEW: When closing an outbound trailer, Acumax triggers outbound EDI 856 (Advance Shipping Notice) transmission. If an order line was split during picking (e.g., partial quantity in carton A, remaining in carton B) and the split line was canceled or re-slotted without clearing the staging reference, the EDI 856 generator fails with ERR_ASN_856_LINE_UNMATCHED. This blocks generation of the legal Bill of Lading (BOL) and holds the trailer at the dock.

DIAGNOSTIC CRITERIA:
1. Trailer close fails with error ERR_ASN_856_LINE_UNMATCHED.
2. EDI staging table contains split record with status 'SPLIT_PENDING' and null carton reference.
3. Manifest carton count differs from EDI line count by exactly 1.

REMEDIATION PROCEDURE (SOP-SHP-521):
Step 1: In Acumax Shipping Console, navigate to 'Trailer Close Reconciliation' -> Enter Trailer ID.
Step 2: Locate the unconfirmed split line item referenced in the EDI error log.
Step 3: Execute 'Reconcile Orphan Split Line' action, selecting 'Void Canceled Split Portion'.
Step 4: Force EDI 856 ASN regeneration from Acumax Outbound EDI Manager.
Step 5: Verify EDI 856 acknowledgment 997 received; release trailer and print final Bill of Lading (BOL).

OWNING SUPPORT GROUP: Acumax Support (Outbound Shipping Module).

knowledge_base.title: Cold Chain Batch Integrity & SAP Material Master Flag Synchronization SOP
knowledge_base.content:
OVERVIEW: Cold chain pharmaceutical products (2-8°C biologics, insulins, vaccines) require strict temperature profile validation during warehouse picking. If the SAP ECC overnight batch synchronization pushes an incorrect storage condition flag (e.g., MARA-TEMPB = 'AMBIENT_15_25' instead of 'COLD_2_8'), Acumax WMS triggers safety interlock error BATCH_TEMP_RANGE_INVALID_BLOCK and halts RF picking to prevent medication compromise.

DIAGNOSTIC CRITERIA:
1. RF guns throw error BATCH_TEMP_RANGE_INVALID_BLOCK in Cold Chain zone.
2. Discrepancy between SAP MM03 storage conditions and Acumax SKU profile.
3. Time out of refrigeration (TOR) alarm active on staged picking totes.

REMEDIATION PROCEDURE (SOP-COLD-612):
Step 1: Immediately move staged pick totes back into 2-8°C walk-in coolers to prevent temperature excursion.
Step 2: Contact Master Data Management (MDM) emergency hotline to rollback MARA-TEMPB table changes in SAP ECC for affected plant.
Step 3: Trigger delta master data sync interface RFC_SAP_ACUMAX_MAT_SYNC.
Step 4: Verify Acumax SKU temperature profile reflects 'COLD_2_8' across all affected SKUs.
Step 5: Resume Cold Chain wave picking tasks on RF terminals.

OWNING SUPPORT GROUP: SAP Master Data Support (Co-assigned to DC Quality Assurance).

knowledge_base.title: ASRS High-Bay Crane Optical Interlock & Dual-Shuttle Gridlock SOP
knowledge_base.content:
OVERVIEW: Automated Storage & Retrieval Systems (ASRS) high-bay cranes utilize dual laser distance meters (LDM-02) and PLC safety interlocks to retrieve pallet loads from rack elevations up to 110 feet. When optical reflector misalignment or dust contamination exceeds 12mm tolerance during high-velocity deceleration, the crane controller triggers safety fault CRANE_OPTICAL_FAULT_ESTOP and halts all crane movements in the aisle, starving downstream pick faces.

DIAGNOSTIC CRITERIA:
1. ASRS WCS console displays CRANE_OPTICAL_FAULT_ESTOP on Crane #3.
2. Crane PLC reports laser reflector deviation > 12mm on Z-axis.
3. Downstream pallet decant conveyor status STARVED_IDLE.

REMEDIATION PROCEDURE (SOP-ASRS-734):
Step 1: In Dematic WCS Engineering Console, engage aisle lockout safety protocol for Aisle 04.
Step 2: Dispatch maintenance technician with optical inspection rig to clean and realign reflector target LDM-02.
Step 3: Execute PLC manual homing sequence from WCS diagnostic terminal: dematic_ctl home --crane CRN-03 --axis ALL.
Step 4: Clear safety software latch: dematic_ctl reset-estop --auth-key MNT-9921.
Step 5: Release queued pallet replenishment tasks and confirm aisle operation resumes.

OWNING SUPPORT GROUP: ASRS & Automation Engineering.

knowledge_base.title: Automated Print-and-Apply (PandA) Applicator Tamp Cylinder Jam Resolution SOP
knowledge_base.content:
OVERVIEW: Automated packaging spurs utilize high-speed Print-and-Apply (PandA) labeling machines equipped with Zebra thermal print engines and pneumatic tamp applicators. If label backing tension drops or vacuum pressure leaks below 4.2 bar, printed shipping labels fail to transfer to carton surfaces, causing pneumatic tamp cylinder timeout ERR_PANDA_TAMP_EXTEND_TIMEOUT and halting the cartonization conveyor line.

DIAGNOSTIC CRITERIA:
1. PandA PLC alarm ERR_PANDA_TAMP_EXTEND_TIMEOUT triggered on Packing Lane 3.
2. Inline optical barcode scanner verifies absence of compliant GS1-128 shipping label on passing carton.
3. Pneumatic regulator pressure reading < 4.5 bar.

REMEDIATION PROCEDURE (SOP-PANDA-812):
Step 1: Pause packing line conveyor infeed to Lane 3 to prevent carton pile-up.
Step 2: Inspect pneumatic vacuum pad for adhesive glue buildup; clean using approved solvent.
Step 3: Verify compressed air regulator line pressure is restored to nominal 6.0 bar.
Step 4: Execute PandA cycle test from control panel: panda_mgr test-cycle --lane 03 --labels 2.
Step 5: Re-engage cartonization conveyor and verify label application on 5 test cartons.

OWNING SUPPORT GROUP: Packing Line Automation Maintenance.

knowledge_base.title: Outbound EDI 214 Carrier Shipment Status & Line-Haul Gate Out Sync SOP
knowledge_base.content:
OVERVIEW: Upon security guardhouse departure, the Yard Management System (YMS) triggers outbound EDI 214 (Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message) to freight carriers (Old Dominion, FedEx Freight). If carrier API token expiration or network timeout blocks EDI 214 acknowledgment, the yard security gate system interlock refuses to lift the physical exit barrier, holding trailers inside the facility gate.

DIAGNOSTIC CRITERIA:
1. Gate exit console displays EDI_214_ACK_TIMEOUT on Trailer ID TRK-8821.
2. YMS outbound queue depth > 0 for carrier Old Dominion.
3. Carrier line-haul dispatch portal indicates status 'PENDING_DEPARTURE'.

REMEDIATION PROCEDURE (SOP-EDI-924):
Step 1: Guardhouse supervisor triggers emergency manual gate release code in YMS console.
Step 2: In Acumax Shipping Console, select 'Resend Carrier EDI 214 Transmission' with relaxed ACK mode.
Step 3: Contact Carrier Integration Helpdesk if authentication error 401 is reported in EDI bridge logs.
Step 4: Verify manual Bill of Lading (BOL) copy has physical driver signature stamped.
Step 5: Archive dispatch event with gate supervisor override reference.

OWNING SUPPORT GROUP: Logistics Carrier Integration & YMS Support.

problem_records.title: High-Volume DC Acumax Wave Deadlock on Concurrent Bulk Replenishment
problem_records.root_cause_summary: Race condition in Acumax WMS v4.2.1 when wave allocation queries table WAVE_HDR_DTL simultaneously with automated high-velocity replenishment trigger. Lock escalation causes deadlock.
problem_records.permanent_fix: Applied Acumax Patch WMS-4.2.1-HF08 which introduces optimistic row locking and isolated replenishment transactions.

problem_records.title: EAI Inbound Broker Sequence Inversion during Network Packet Reordering
problem_records.root_cause_summary: Multi-threaded RFC gateway in EAI WebMethods permitted packet interleaving under sustained 500+ msg/sec bursts, triggering strict FIFO sequence check rejects.
problem_records.permanent_fix: Configured EAI adapter to use single-threaded partitioned consumer per DC routing key with 5-second out-of-order jitter buffer.

problem_records.title: Conveyor Sorter High-Speed Scanner Optical Drift & Dust Accumulation
problem_records.root_cause_summary: Accumulation of corrugated fiber dust on Cognex overhead optical sensors reduces contrast sensitivity, causing read timeouts at conveyor speeds > 320 ft/min.
problem_records.permanent_fix: Installed positive air pressure blowers on camera housings and automated daily lens cleaning schedule.

problem_records.title: Truck Close EDI 856 ASN Rejection on Unconfirmed Partial Order Splits
problem_records.root_cause_summary: Acumax picking engine created temporary split child lines that were not purged upon pick cancellation, creating mismatch against shipping manifest header count.
problem_records.permanent_fix: Added database trigger on WAVE_PICK_DTL to automatically purge ghost split records upon wave completion.

problem_records.title: ASRS High-Bay Optical Distance Sensor Misalignment under Thermal Expansion
problem_records.root_cause_summary: Thermal roof expansion during summer peak causes 14mm deflection in high-bay rack guide rails, tripping laser distance meter tolerance safety gates.
problem_records.permanent_fix: Installed floating compensator brackets on laser target reflectors and upgraded PLC firmware to include dynamic thermal calibration offset.

problem_records.title: Print and Apply Pneumatic Tamp Vacuum Seal Adhesive Accumulation
problem_records.root_cause_summary: Adhesive bleed from hot-melt label stock coats PandA vacuum suction cups after 8,000 cycles, causing tamp cylinder extension timeout errors.
problem_records.permanent_fix: Switched to non-stick fluoropolymer vacuum suction cups and added automated shift cleaning protocol.

problem_records.title: Outbound EDI 214 Carrier OAuth Token Expiration on Midnight Rollover
problem_records.root_cause_summary: Carrier Old Dominion API gateway expires OAuth tokens at 00:00 UTC without proactive refresh in YMS broker, causing 401 Unauthorized errors on night line-hauls.
problem_records.permanent_fix: Implemented proactive token refresh daemon with 60-minute pre-expiration renewal window in EAI bridge.
